preview: {"scripts": ["frame_sql='''WITH r AS (SELECT citing_work_id AS work_id, list(DISTINCT cited_work_id ORDER BY cited_work_id) AS refs FROM citations WHERE regexp_full_match(cited_work_id,'W[0-9]+') AND citing_work_id<>cited_work_id GROUP BY 1), y AS (SELECT w.work_id, sum(y.cited_by_count) later_year_citations FROM works w JOIN work_citations_by_year y ON y.work_id=w.work_id AND y.year>w.publication_year AND y.year<=2026 GROUP BY 1), l AS (SELECT w.work_id, count(DISTINCT c.citing_work_id) local_later_citations FROM citations c JOIN works w ON c.cited_work_id=w.work_id JOIN works s ON c.citing_work_id=s.work_id AND s.publication_date>w.publication_date GROUP BY 1) SELECT w.work_id, w.publication_date, w.publication_year, w.authors_count, w.cited_by_count AS snapshot_cited_by_count, w.type, w.primary_topic_id, w.primary_field, w.primary_subfield, w.source_id, w.referenced_works_count, coalesce(len(r.refs),0) AS usable_refs, coalesce(y.later_year_citations,0) AS later_year_citations,coalesce(l.local_later_citations,0) AS local_later_citations, r.refs FROM works w LEFT JOIN r USING(work_id) LEFT JOIN y USING(work_id) LEFT JOIN l USING(work_id) ORDER BY work_id'''\nfrom datetime import date, timedelta\nframe=sql(frame_sql); frame['frame_status']=np.select([frame.usable_refs.eq(0),frame[['snapshot_cited_by_count','later_year_citations','local_later_citations']].max(axis=1).le(0)],['no_usable_refs','no_citation_evidence'],default='eligible'); labels=[str(i) for i in range(1,11)]+['11
